stage. Tasks You develop and improve the distributional forecasting
models of a growing software company in the grocery retail sector,
working across model architecture, calibration and coverage You deepen
existing production models, monitor forecast quality metrics
continuously and act quickly when performance degrades You identify
where current approaches reach their limits and shape what comes next
methodologically You make substantial contributions to the inventory
simulation and ordering policy framework and drive improvements
through to production You shape the technical direction in your focus
area, contribute to methodology decisions and hold a high bar for code
quality, testability and production readiness across the team You take

engineering, product, sales and customer operations and translate
operational findings from store level into product improvements
Profile You hold an MSc or PhD in a quantitative field such as
statistics, mathematics, physics, operations research or computer

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
In a Nutshell

As a

Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d)
, you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord. You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.

Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.

Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.

Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.

Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.

You hold a Ausbildung and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)
You have 7+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role
You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems
You have been working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team
At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way
You're fluent in English, German

Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.

Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.

Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.

Kickstart your career: Join our international team in an environment that fosters real growth and an “Act like an Owner” mentality. Here, you’ll have the chance to drive projects independently, test new ideas, and level up through specialized Lepaya trainings to see firsthand how your work makes an impact.

Sustainability at Core: Be part of the revolution. You’ll contribute to a greener future through our 100% electric fleet and a business model designed to drastically reduce food waste.

The Essentials: We provide the tools for success, including a laptop and phone, and access to exclusive Corporate Benefits discounts for travel, tech and more.

Unforgettable Moments: From our legendary annual ski trip, our massive Christmas parties, to parties featuring our very own Picnic band, we make sure our milestones are celebrated in style.

Well-being & Balance: Professional mental health support via OpenUp.

This includes collaboration in planning, installation, and operations. We support continuous professional development to stay up to date with current technology. - Experience leading change in a multiple site environments

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Germany: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 66.67% bonus target + equity + benefits

Intelligence Center X combines the Mendix low-code platform with Siemens' Graph Studio and AI Studio software to enable enterprises to deploy AI-driven applications and agents faster, with full traceability and control. By connecting data, models, and workflows on a single governed foundation, Intelligence Center X helps companies turn AI ambition into real value gains.
In this role, you will help our customers transform their businesses by addressing a critical market challenge: while companies have invested heavily in AI, many struggle to scale beyond pilots due to fragmented data, inconsistent governance, and disconnected insights. Intelligence Center X closes that gap as the production-ready system that orchestrates people and AI agents together, with full auditability and policy controls. You'll work with enterprise leaders across industries to demonstrate how Intelligence Center X enables proactive, data-driven decision-making and automated workflows that drive efficiency and competitive advantage.

• Data strategy & automation: Showcase how Intelligence Center X enables organizations to adopt proactive, data-driven approaches and automated insights for smarter decisions
• Take ownership: Lead the entire sales cycle – from uncovering opportunities to facilitating negotiations and achieving successful deals

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-step sales cycles and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• Passion for data-driven strategies, digital transformation, and automation-focused solutions

Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

We’re looking for a passionate and highly skilled (Senior) Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join our Medical Affairs team. In this field based role, you will drive scientific engagement, support clinical development, and shape our medical strategy within your assigned region. You will serve as a trusted scientific expert, build impactful relationships with KOLs, and play a key role in bringing innovative therapies to patients.

The focus area within Germany for this position in Mid Germany is Rhein/Ruhr, Köln, Gießen/Mainz/Frankfurt, Göttingen/Erfurt, Leipzig, Dresden .
Ideally the future position holder lives in that area.

Key responsibilities will include:
•    Serve as a scientific expert to the medical community and facilitate the appropriate exchange of scientific information
•    Build and maintain strong scientific relationships with national, regional, and local KOLs
•    Gather and communicate medical insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes
•    Support investigator initiated research as primary liaison
•    Provide scientific support at national and European congresses, advisory boards, and medical programs
•    Lead selected national medical projects and initiatives
•    Provide clinical presentations and information in response to unsolicited questions (as appropriate) in academic, non-academic, and healthcare provider settings
•    Collaborate with Clinical Operations to support trial site identification and patient enrollment
•    Develop and execute territory plans aligned with national and regional medical strategy
•    Partner with HEOR/Market Access to support health economic and outcomes data generation
•    Support Medical Information requests
•    Assist the Country Medical Director in shaping national KOL engagement and medical plans
•    Mentor new or less experienced MSLs
•    Support onboarding and training of field medical and commercial colleagues
•    Contribute to national and regional medical strategy as a senior team member

Who you are:
•    Advanced scientific degree (MD, PhD, PharmD or equivalent)
•    Minimum 5 years of MSL experience
•    Experience in rare diseases preferred; oncology or neuroscience a plus
•    Strong ability to communicate and present complex scientific information
•    Self driven, collaborative, and comfortable working independently

•    Valid driver license

•   German native level, English fluent

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Informations-, Kommunikationstechnik)
jobs.description:
NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.

We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.

Tasks

- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.
- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.
- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.
- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.
- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.
- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.
- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.

Qualifications

- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).
- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.
- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).
- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.
- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.
- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.
- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.

Benefits

- Hybrid working model.
- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.
- Modern office space with very good transport connections.
- Various employee discounts for activities and products.
- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
- Numerous training and development opportunities.
- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: vEFK - Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft / Qualified Electrician (m/f/d) (Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced **vEFK (Electrical Safety Manager)** to take on formal electrical safety responsibility for our drone production facility, in accordance with DGUV Vorschrift 3 and DIN VDE 0105-100. As vEFK, you will be the designated person accountable for the safe operation, maintenance, and modification of all electrical systems and equipment across production lines, test benches, and facility infrastructure.

Your Road Map To Make an Impact

- Assume formal responsibility (per §13 DGUV V3 / VDE 0105) for electrical safety across the production facility, including assembly lines, battery test/charging stations, RF and avionics test benches, and building electrical systems
- Issue, review, and sign off on electrical work permits and switching authorizations
- Conduct and document risk assessments for electrical work (live working, lockout/tagout, isolation procedures)
- Supervise and coordinate Elektrofachkräfte (EFK) and elektrotechnisch unterwiesene Personen (EuP) on site
- Oversee inspection and testing of electrical equipment, machinery, and battery/charging infrastructure (per DGUV V3, VDE 0701-0702, and applicable Li-ion battery handling standards)
- Manage compliance with low-voltage directive, EMC requirements, and relevant drone/UAV manufacturing electrical safety standards
- Investigate electrical incidents, near-misses, and non-conformances; drive corrective actions
- Maintain documentation: circuit diagrams, inspection logs, training records, and safety instructions (Betriebsanweisungen)
- Liaise with quality, EHS, and engineering teams on electrical aspects of new production line rollouts and equipment procurement
- Train and qualify personnel on electrical safety procedures specific to drone assembly (e.g., high-density battery packs, motor/ESC testing, RF equipment)

Job requirements

- Completed vocational/technical training as Elektroniker, Elektroinstallateur, or equivalent, plus further qualification enabling appointment as vEFK (e.g., Meister, Techniker, or Ingenieur in Elektrotechnik)
- Formal written appointment eligibility as vEFK per employer's organizational delegation (Unternehmerpflichtenübertragung)
- Several years of hands-on experience in industrial electrical systems, ideally in manufacturing/production environments
- Sound knowledge of DGUV Vorschrift 3, VDE 0100/0105, VDE 0701-0702, and low-voltage directive requirements
- Experience with battery systems (Li-Po/Li-ion) and their associated electrical hazards is highly desirable given the UAV/drone context
- Strong documentation discipline and ability to train/supervise other electrical personnel
- Fluent German (technical/regulatory) and good working English (for international engineering teams)

Preferred / Nice to Have

- Experience in aerospace, UAV, or electronics/precision manufacturing
- Familiarity with ESD-sensitive component handling
- Knowledge of RF/EMC testing environments
- Experience with automated or semi-automated production line electrical systems

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Marketing Manager (w/m/d) (Leiter/in - Marketing)
jobs.description:
Ready for a Challenge

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery, and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role:

As a Senior Partner Marketing Manager within the German marketing team, you will play a pivotal role in driving brand and partner success, reporting directly to the Head of Partner Germany. Your core mission will be to champion and accelerate the growth of our restaurant partners in Berlin and Germany.

You will be the strategic and creative engine behind these key accounts, responsible for creating robust Growth Joint Business Plans (JBPs), and owning the end-to-end execution and performance monitoring of co-marketing campaigns.

By aligning Lieferando’s brand power with the cult status of local favorites, you will drive market share, highlight destination supply, and execute impactful activations that resonate deeply with local food lovers.

You build custom co-marketing plans, run high-impact campaigns, and make sure food lovers choose Lieferando whenever they crave their favorite local bites.

Think of it like being an artist manager for celebrity restaurants. You take local legend brands that people already love, throw the full weight of Lieferando's marketing engine behind them, and throw fuel on the fire so both sides win big.

Key Ingredients to the Role:

- Strategic Joint Business Planning: Own the marketing relationship with the restaurant partners, co-create and align on comprehensive Growth Joint Business Plans (JBPs) that drive mutual volume and brand loyalty.
- Campaign Execution & Ownership: Plan, launch, and project-manage multi-channel marketing campaigns tailored to these specific local hero chains, driving customer acquisition, engagement, and order frequency.
- Performance Monitoring & Analytics: Constantly monitor, analyze, and report on marketing performance against KPIs. Use data-driven insights to optimise ROI and uncover new growth levers for your assigned brands.
- Local Hyper-Presence: Drive impactful on-the-ground activations and hyper-local campaigns to ensure strong brand presence across all relevant physical and digital touchpoints.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the central bridge between these key restaurant partners, local sales/account management teams, and our global HQ teams (Creative Studio, CRM, Digital, PR) to execute seamless campaigns.

What will you bring to the table?

- Language & Market Expertise: Fluent in German and English (written and spoken) is essential; deep, intimate knowledge of the German consumer landscape—strong Berlin market knowledge is a major plus.
- Proven Experience: Several years of marketing experience, ideally rooted in food delivery, quick-service restaurant (QSR) marketing, tech, or account-based partner marketing.
- Commercial & Strategic Understanding: Proven experience building collaborative growth plans or joint business plans (JBPs) with external commercial partners or corporate accounts.
- Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven instincts with the ability to monitor campaign performance, draw clear conclusions, and pivot strategies based on hard metrics.
- Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the confidence to manage relationships with fast-moving, high-profile restaurant founders and internal corporate stakeholders alike.
- Execution & Agility: A proactive, independent problem-solver who excels in dynamic environments, possesses strong organizational skills, and brings a positive, test-and-learn attitude.

Our Offer

Just like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! With us, you can expect:

- 💰 Competitive Compensation: A salary package that recognises your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.
- 📝 Flexibility: A permanent employment contract with hybrid work options: three days per week in our Berlin-Kreuzberg office and two days working from the comfort of your home.
- 🏋️‍♀️ Urban Sports Club Membership: For your work-life balance and a clear head in your daily routine.
- 🍽️ Additional Perks: A monthly travel allowance of €59 and a €90 monthly Lieferando Pay credit to have delicious food delivered straight to your workspace.
- 🏠 Company Pension: A company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution.
- 🌐 Diversity & Inclusion: A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from over 99 nations, plus the opportunity to join our various communities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).
- 😎 Shared Experiences: After-work drinks, regular team events, social engagement activities, as well as our summer and/or winter parties.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging 

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. 

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture, or company? Have a look at ourcareer site (https://careers.justeattakeaway.com/global/en/home) where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.

jobs.occupation: Scientist (m/f/d) (100%) (Data Scientist)
jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

Within the EU-funded research project "MEDSoil+: Excellence in Mediterranean Soil Regeneration", the Mediterranean Institute for Agriculture, Environment and Development (MED) of the University of Évora (UE, Portugal) will be positioned as the first fully accredited soil lab infrastructure in Portugal capable of generating high-quality, standardised and interoperable soil monitoring data, by training, co-designing innovation, demonstrating and disseminating breakthrough knowledge through Living Labs (LL). The ATB will accompany and consult this process and will be particularly responsible for establishing proximal & remote sensing and IoT solutions for connected soil health mapping and monitoring. For this task, we are looking for the following person from 1 January 2027

Scientist (m/f/d) (100%)

Yourtasks

- Utilise proximal and remote sensing technologies to generate high-spatial-resolution soil property maps
- Deploy IoT and remote sensing technologies to establish a soil health monitoring system delivering high-temporal-resolution data streams
- Establish a federated soil data platform combining decentralised data access and governance with a secure central repository, integrating scientific data, sensor outputs and local knowledge to support soil intelligence, research and policymaking
- Develop robust AI and machine-learning algorithms for soil data fusion, predictive analytics, uncertainty quantification and scenario modelling
- Co-design, adapt and integrate user-oriented decision support systems (DSS) that translate soil intelligence, predictive uncertainty and AI-driven analytics into actionable and reliable recommendations for farmers, land managers and landowners

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree (Master/Diploma) and ideally a PhD with focus in soil science and data science
- Very good knowledge and experience in sensor-based soil mapping and DSS
- Very good knowledge and experience in optical spectroscopy, sensor calibration and data science
- Very good programming skills (R, Python)
- Knowledge in agriculture, soil science, proximal and remote sensing and geographic information systems
- Very good written and spoken English and good knowledge of German
